verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs say it connects through official drivers and APIs for several languages. They list DuckDB SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java as the way to reach MotherDuck, and MotherDuck ships its own Wasm Client library for browser apps. An OpenAPI spec is also published. Missing for 10: in-depth per-SDK reference documentation in the evidence, clarity on which SDKs are MotherDuck-maintained versus DuckDB-native, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
